details.question: Combien de sejours au total ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours

details.question: Quel est le cout moyen d'un sejour ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT AVG(cout_sejour) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours

details.question: Quel est le cout total de tous les sejours ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT SUM(cout_sejour) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours;

details.question: Quel est le cout maximum d'un sejour ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT MAX(cout_sejour) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours

details.question: Quel est le cout minimum d'un sejour ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT MIN(cout_sejour) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours

details.question: Quel est le GHM le plus frequent ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT ghm FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours GROUP BY ghm ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

details.question: Combien de sejours par GHM ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT ghm, COUNT(*) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours GROUP BY ghm;

details.question: Combien de sejours par unite medicale ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT urmp, COUNT(*) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours GROUP BY urmp;

details.question: Combien de sejours pour le GHM 05M092 ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours WHERE ghm LIKE '05M092'

details.question: Combien de sejours avec le diagnostic I500 ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours WHERE dp LIKE 'I500%'

details.question: Combien de patients hospitalises en 2024 ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT nip) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_entree) = 2024;

details.question: Combien de sejours en janvier 2024 ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_entree) = 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_entree) = 2024;

details.question: Combien de sejours ont dure plus de 10 jours ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours WHERE CAST(duree_sejour AS INTEGER) > 10;

details.question: Quel est le tarif moyen ATIH ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT AVG(tarif_base) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours;

details.question: Quel est le tarif total ATIH ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT SUM(tarif_base) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours;

details.question: Combien de patients readmis a J30 ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.dataset_ml WHERE pathologie = 'J30'

details.question: Quels sont les diagnostics principaux les plus frequents ?
details.sql_genere:
SELECT dp, COUNT(*) 
FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours 
GROUP BY dp

details.question: Supprime tous les sejours
details.sql_genere: DELETE FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours;

details.question: Execute DELETE FROM ic_couts_sejours
details.sql_genere: DELETE FROM ic_couts_sejours

details.question: Quel GHM a le cout moyen le plus eleve ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT ghm, AVG(cout_sejour) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours GROUP BY ghm;

details.question: Combien de sejours ont un cout superieur a 5000 euros ?
details.sql_genere: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pmsi_mco_analytics.ic_couts_sejours WHERE cout_sejour > 5000;
